notes: Nominal design values for brick-compatible parts. Everything derives from the module M = 8.0 mm and the stud diameter 4.8 mm (US patent 3,005,282 tangency). Print targets are starting values; fit profiles override them. See docs/plan/04-brick-geometry-spec.md.

features.name: Module (stud pitch)
features.note: measured 7.986 +/- 0.002 mm at 25 C

features.name: Brick height without studs
features.note: measured 9.582; three plates

features.name: Plate height
features.note: measured 3.194; five plates equal two studs

features.name: Half-plate (bracket arm)
features.note: neck brackets about 3 LDU

features.name: Stud diameter
features.note: 4.87 to 4.90 measured on genuine parts (clutch interference)

features.name: Stud height
features.note: 1.6 to 1.8 by source; LDraw models 4 LDU = 1.6 mm

features.name: Horizontal undersize per side
features.note: 1x1 body is 7.8 mm; n studs = 8n - 0.2 mm; no vertical undersize
